text_sections.label: Special Digivolution Condition
text_sections.text: [Digivolve] Lv.5 w/[Garurumon] in name or w/[ADVENTURE]/[Hero] trait: Cost 3

text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text: ＜Blocker＞ ＜Evade＞ [On Play] [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] Delete 1 of your opponent's level 5 or lower Digimon. Then, for every 2 of your Tamers' colors, 1 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers can't suspend until their turn ends. [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When any of your Digimon suspend, this Digimon may unsuspend.

text_sections.label: Inherited Effect
text_sections.text: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] If this Digimon has [Garurumon] or [Omnimon] in its name, 1 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers can't suspend until their turn ends.
